title: The menu bar apps' copies in arca_swift: the row's image and icon, and ArcaLaunch (issue 0003)
objective: arca_swift carries what each estate menu bar app copies today (issue 0003), so that the apps stop copying it: the masthead row asks for its image on macOS 27, the row can take its icon from the bundle's icon file, and a new product, ArcaLaunch, carries the XCTest-host check and a single-instance guard as one call that an app's applicationDidFinishLaunching makes first. It ships as 0.3.0, and Utilz's menuz moves to it under Utilz issue 0114.
